body:
This is a Datapack compatible for 1.16.5 minecraft, it addes the missing recipes like chainmail armour, saddle, trident and others.

1.17,1.18,1.19 version will be available soon.

The crafting recipes and given in the gallery page.

This Datapack is inspired from Mysticat's Datapack, but has some changed recipes that are made by me.

It has also changed some crafting recipes like chains and ladders to make it easier to play

Any suggestions are welcomed on my discord server, link in external links
